minion-hunter.evidence: Actual six-page public publisher/DriveThruRPG sample 60396-sample.pdf successfully retrieved unchanged. Original title, GDW/FFE marks, 1992 copyright and Lester Smith credits match the named Minion Hunter Dark Conspiracy boardgame. All six original sample pages were visually read and freshly forced English OCRed because the existing native layer is badly garbled and interleaves columns. PDF1 is contents; PDF2 is rules-file cover; PDF3–6 reproduce original printed pages2–5. They supply introduction/components, setup with no initial money, twelve unexamined Plot Cards removed, one initial point in each attribute, highest D10 first/clockwise, first-turn off-board corner choice and Security Training correction to +2 Combat, location-dependent player turns, exact D6 career movement either direction, corner-to-map choice, map travel/declared vehicle and public-transport costs/encounter interruption, hospital recovery, after-each-player Plot Card movement/reveal and replacement timing, and initial attribute definitions. This is a usable scoped RULES_REFERENCE_PDF, not the full original manual or full game download. The sample ends mid Gaining Attribute Points on printed5. Remaining attributes/testing, equipment, complete Plot Card effects, combat, encounter/transport tables, victory/endings, Grimmer Options and maps/cards/pawns/money are unavailable in this sample. The file cover advertises nine rule pages including Grimmer Options while the original component description calls the core book eight pages; these distinct descriptions are preserved. Contents lists Minion Nation in the full paid bundle, but no expansion rules are present in this six-page sample or merged into base rules. Sample-file watermark remains unchanged and causes OCR losses; images govern all obscured wording, numbers and diagrams. The paid store GET returned403 and was not bypassed. A different Scribd upload exposes no ordinary current readable rule text; its cached text and purchaser metadata are excluded. No purchase, login or restricted download. One specific MAJOR turn-order finding is supported by original printed3and5; no full summary audit, PASS or summary body repair.
minion-hunter.specific_finding: The summary gives every turn four universal phases: Career, Equipment, Plot advances, then Action (move/investigate/combat). The original public sample, printed3/PDF4, instead says a Game Turn consists of one Player Turn followed by a Plot Card Turn. What the player does depends on the pawn’s location at the beginning of the turn; after movement and resulting effects the Player Turn ends. Printed5/PDF6 then advances the Plot Card immediately after that completed Player Turn. The summary both invents universal career/equipment phases and moves the plot advance ahead of the action it should follow, changing what threats remain available to encounter. Specific MAJOR against the original sample; full later rules and victory remain unavailable. No full audit or body repair.
